1. Heard counsel for the applicant and Sri Neeraj Kumar Sharma, learned Aga for the
State-opposite party.

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2.The instant bail application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. has been filed with the prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 340 of 2023, under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 120B of I.P.C., Police Station Dakshin, District Firozabad, during the pendency of the trial.
3. Counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the present case.
The applicant is the marginal witness of the sale deed dated 08.06.2021.
No amount was credited in the account of the applicant.
The applicant is not a beneficiary of the illicit transaction.
Even, otherwise, the sale consideration was not credited/transferred in the account of the imposter.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The applicant is in jail since 05.07.2024, having no criminal history and in case, he is enlarged on bail, he will not misuse the said liberty.
4. Learned AGA has opposed the prayer for bail but could not satisfactorily dispute the aforesaid submissions from the record.
5. Having heard counsel for the parties and having perused the record this Court prima facie finds that the applicant is the marginal witness of the sale deed dated 08.06.2021.
No amount has been credited in the bank account of the applicant.
At this stage, there is no substantive evidence against the applicant.

Further, the applicant has no criminal antecedents and has remained confined for more than four months and after submission of the charge-sheet there is no hope of early conclusion of trial, more so when no reasonable apprehension has been brought to the fore by the State that the applicant, if enlarged on bail, would either tamper with the evidence or delay the trial or intimidate the witness, without commenting on merits of the case, I am of the opinion that the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
7. In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the prosecution shall be at liberty to move bail cancellation application before this Court.
